newsitem.title: UK: ICI to raise $500 mln from bonds - FT.
newsitem.headline: ICI to raise $500 mln from bonds - FT.

text.p: British chemicals giant ICI is to raise about $500 million from the eurobond market on Friday or early next week in the first stage of a $4 billion fundraising exercise to cut the cost of its borrowing, the Financial Times reported.

It said this will be the first time ICI has tapped the international capital markets since the 1993 demerger of Zeneca, its pharmaceutical business, and will significantly increase the availability of ICI debt.
Joint lead managers UBS and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, quoted by the paper, said they intended the new bond to be a benchmark issue.
Analysts cited by the Financial Times said they expected a fixed-rate bond with a maturity of between three and five years.
